# Coverage inventory

Paths below are repository-relative. “Existing” identifies reusable checks;
it does not mean they consume the compact suite or that an optional external
program actually ran. New tests in `crates/*/tests/compact.rs` run in workspace
CI without a cache. Python invariants in `testdata/compact/test_suite.py` are
also mandatory. No production behavior is changed by these fixtures.

| Area | New fixture / exact consumer | Existing coverage reused | Remaining gap / limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sequence IO | `sequences-annotations/*`, `alignment-editing/identifiers.fasta`, `recovery-errors/invalid/*`; `basecraft-io/tests/compact.rs::sequence_annotations_have_independent_coordinates_and_roundtrip`, `fasta_preserves_duplicate_unicode_ids_wrapping_and_crlf`, `malformed_formats_return_errors` | `basecraft-io/src/fasta.rs` indexing tests; old `tests/testdata.rs` optional larger generator round trips | FASTA indexing is not alphabet validation; distance consumer rejects symbols. GenBank accepts missing terminator/truncated ORIGIN: explicit probe, no false rejection claim. |
| Annotation/coordinates | `locus.gb/.gff3/.fasta`; IO compact test checks [0,61),[90,209),[241,421), phase 2 on second joined exon, reverse strand, sequence bounds and semantic round trips; Python `test_annotation_sequence_truth` checks splice and reverse CDS | `basecraft-ops/tests/replay.rs::extract_clips_annotations_and_marks_cuts_incomplete`, `extracts_spliced_cds_and_reverse_complements`; `basecraft-io/src/gff3.rs` tests | No new partial CDS/overlap fixture; existing extraction tests cover partial flags. Cross-file out-of-range sidecar validation is not comprehensively exercised here. |
| Alignment editing | `homologues.afa`, `unaligned.fasta`, `ambiguous-gappy.afa`, duplicate Unicode IDs; `basecraft-ops/tests/compact.rs::compact_alignment_unicode_path_edit_undo_save_reopen_replay`; distance compact invalid test | `basecraft-ops/tests/replay.rs::alignment_session_replays_exactly`, `sequence_addition_expands_reference_and_replays_with_undo` | New consumer tests edit/undo/reopen/replay and ID retention, not GUI select/copy. Zero/single-row GUI cases remain separate. |

No fabricated run/result JSON masquerading as real analysis provenance. |
| File identity / workflow | Unicode/space path in ops compact test; demo folders mix sidecars, alignments, trees and SPART | Passive-record test above; project picker tests `basecraft-gui/tests/qml/tst_file_tree.qml` | Result JSON must be created by an actual analysis in a demo. | Jobs / cancellation / budgets | Eight-by-180 default alignment; Python `test_committed_bytes_hashes_and_budget` bounds suite <100 KB; generation is deterministic and quick | Delimitation engine cancellation/hash test above; distance `bootstrap.rs::tests::original_errors_saturation_overlap_cache_and_cancellation_are_explicit`; MAFFT CPU-allocation tests | No timing-sensitive cancellation trigger added. Concurrent global limits and stale GUI status remain separate integration tests; moderate/full stress remains opt-in. |

Format expectations are intentionally scoped. An empty FASTA has zero indexed
records and is rejected by alignment analysis. Duplicate IDs remain intact in
IO and are rejected by scientific consumers. Unsupported symbols are rejected
by the distance alignment validator. Tests never accept silent renaming as a
solution. Synthetic invalid files are robustness probes, not biological data.
